title: Early arrival, unit not ready
summary: Synthetic facts from a PMS, a housekeeping system and a guest messaging platform for one property. Replay events.jsonl in file order through an implementation and compare its dispositions, readiness and situations with expected.json. The situations are non-normative; the dispositions follow the HOS Events 0.1 processing rules.

deliveries.note: The PMS created reservation res_1042 on 12 July for an arrival today. The guest is a pseudonymous id; the PMS confirmation number travels as a typed external reference.
The PMS expects stay_1042 today, with the standard check-in at 15:00.
The PMS assigns unit 204. Assignment is a fact of its own, so the stay keeps an assignment history.
The housekeeping system, the declared authority for housekeeping status, reports unit 204 dirty after the previous guest left. Only that dimension changes.
The same event arrives again, as at-least-once delivery allows. Same source and id: it is ignored.
The housekeeping system creates cleaning task task_88 for unit 204. Its causal link points to the departure status change.
The PMS publishes a housekeeping task, but its manifest does not declare that capability at this property. Undeclared means denied: HOS ignores it.

deliveries.checks: A task is not a status
deliveries.note: Task task_88 is reported complete. At this property only the supervisor's inspection releases a unit, so the authoritative status is still dirty.

The PMS flips unit 204 to clean because the task closed. Its manifest declares it non-authoritative for housekeeping, so HOS records the disagreement instead of merging it. A front desk trusting the PMS would hand over a room nobody released.

At 11:40 the guest writes that they will arrive around 12:30, before the 15:00 check-in. Only the extracted signal travels, not the message. The unit is not ready: the reference projection raises arrival.room_readiness_at_risk with its evidence.
An earlier message (11:05, arriving 12:00) is delivered late. Its signal is older than the 11:40 one, so it does not replace it.

The housekeeping webhook was down while the supervisor inspected unit 204. On recovery the system sends an explicit, sensitivity-classified snapshot. The authoritative status becomes inspected: the risk is resolved 14 minutes before the guest arrives.
The guest checks in at 12:35 into an inspected unit.
